notes:
The sheet (manuscript page 14) juxtaposes loops on a punctured sphere/plane, conjugation by epsilon, and a trial definition of equivariant path composition. The first ordered product of the lambdas is crossed out and replaced by the reverse order. The source labels the lower sphere pole `-\bar i`; although that is unexpected beside the other i/-i pictures, both the minus and the bar are visible and are retained. The letters formerly read r and lambda inside two curves are arrowheads.

For ell: gamma a -> b and ell-prime: gamma-prime b -> c, applying gamma-prime to ell gives gamma-prime gamma a -> gamma-prime b, so the corrected composite is ell-prime circ gamma-prime(ell). This typing check supports the inserted final component, but the inconsistent earlier a -> gamma gamma-prime c trial remains in the transcription. The tiny second inverse index is read 1: it is solid and short, whereas the 0 above is an oval. This notation comparison, with the parallel conjugation equations, supports rather than replaces the ink. The diagonal stroke over ell circ bar ell is recorded as cancellation; its possible inverse exponent remains uncertain. No prose date or verbal self-check occurs here.
